frames.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create one production animation frame W1 for Miffy's garden walk version 2. Edit/reference roles: image 1 is old profile walk framing/can model ONLY, not its timid stride; image 2 is canonical Miffy identity; image 3 is watering-sheet reference for apparent scale and baseline.
Output one square image on perfectly flat solid chroma green #00FF00 (background will be removed with existing helper). No text, labels, ground line, shadow or water.
Miffy is a white rabbit in simple flat Dick Bruna-like children's-book style, round head, two upright ears, one visible dot eye and small x mouth on right profile, pink dress with scalloped collar and white button, white feet, clean even black outlines. Face RIGHT, exact profile like image 1. Carry image 1's same upright BLUE watering can in front paw with bent carrying arm, its spout pointing right; never tilt/pour.
W1 CONTACT RIGHT FOOT: deliberately clear comfortable stride. Near/right foot forward towards right, heel on ground and toes slightly raised; far/left foot behind towards left, toe on ground and heel raised. Two distinct white legs below hem, no extra limbs. Free/far arm swings backwards, opposite forward right leg, visible to left of torso. Calm cheerful.
Framing in 627x627 coordinate equivalents: fixed torso horizontal center x=310, contact ground baseline y=568, top of ears around y=30. Match WATERING reference apparent scale, head width about 235px and round head height about 190px, full ears plus head about 330px, body from neck y=353 to hem near y=518. Upright can lies in front at x=360..500, carrying hand around y=416. All subject fits with padding. Maintain head relative to torso, wardrobe, colours and line weight. Future three frames will keep this exact head, torso, can, carrying arm and their geometry; only leg phases, free arm swing and whole body bob may differ. Flat fills, no textures/gradients. Do not include flower or background scenery.
